files.config.py: Hyperparameters as module-level constants, plus two import-time assertions
files.data.py: Corpus loading, encoding, split, windows, batches
files.ops.py: Differentiable operations with hand-written backward functions
files.gradcheck.py: Finite-difference gradient checker, used only by tests
files.optim.py: Adam with decoupled weight decay, learning-rate schedule, gradient clipping
files.checkpoint.py: Save and load weights, model shape and tokenizer

symbols.tokenizer.merge_tokens: Replaces adjacent `pair` occurrences with `merged`, scanning left to right
symbols.tokenizer.apply_merges: Pre-tokenizes text and replays all merges on each pre-token
symbols.tokenizer.Tokenizer: Holds merges and vocabulary; encodes and decodes
symbols.tokenizer.Tokenizer.__init__: Stores its arguments and sets `vocab_size = len(itos)`
symbols.tokenizer.Tokenizer.encode: Text to ids; tokens not in the vocabulary map to the `<unk>` id
symbols.tokenizer.Tokenizer.decode: Ids to text by joining `itos` entries
symbols.tokenizer.build_tokenizer: Trains merges, builds `itos` (`<unk>`, then characters, then merged tokens) and `stoi`
symbols.data.load_corpus: Reads up to `max_rows` CSV rows, drops missing values, strips, joins with newlines, adds a final newline
symbols.data.split_ids: Splits the id stream without shuffling: leading part is train, trailing part is validation
symbols.data.make_windows: Returns input and target `pandas` DataFrames of sliding windows
symbols.data.iterate_batches: Yields batches as NumPy arrays; keeps a final short batch
symbols.ops.xavier_uniform: Samples a `(fan_in, fan_out)` matrix from a uniform distribution
symbols.ops.softmax_forward: Softmax on the last axis, with the maximum subtracted first
symbols.ops.cross_entropy_forward: Returns the mean cross-entropy and the probabilities
symbols.ops.cross_entropy_backward: Returns the gradient with respect to the logits
symbols.ops.layer_norm_forward: Layer norm; returns the output and cache `(Xhat, s)`
symbols.gradcheck.numerical_grad: Central-difference gradient of every element of `x`
symbols.gradcheck.check_params: Worst relative error per parameter at randomly sampled indices
symbols.transformer.ModelConfig: Frozen dataclass of the model shape; `ln_eps` defaults to `1e-5`
symbols.transformer.init_params: Builds the flat dictionary of parameter arrays
symbols.transformer.attention_forward: Multi-head causal self-attention; returns output and cache
symbols.transformer.ffn_forward: Linear, ReLU, linear; returns output and cache
symbols.transformer.block_forward: One pre-LN block; returns output and cache
symbols.transformer.block_backward: Backward through one block; returns the input gradient
symbols.transformer.forward: Whole model on one sequence; returns logits and cache
symbols.transformer.loss_and_grads: Forward, loss and full backward for one sequence
symbols.optim.Adam.__init__: Creates zeroed `m` and `v`, sets `t = 0`, stores settings
symbols.optim.Adam.step: One in-place update, with decay only where `ndim >= 2`
symbols.optim.clip_grad_norm: Global-norm clipping in place; returns the norm before clipping
symbols.generate.generate: Appends sampled ids, feeding `forward` the last `window` ids
symbols.checkpoint.load_checkpoint: Reads the three files and rebuilds `stoi` from `itos`
symbols.train.batch_loss_and_grads: Loops over a batch and averages loss and gradients
symbols.train.validation_loss: Mean cross-entropy over all validation windows
symbols.train.main: Full training pipeline; entry point at lines 84-85
symbols.talk.main: Loads a checkpoint and runs the prompt loop; entry point at lines 29-30
symbols.tests.test_checkpoint.saved: Fixture: saves a checkpoint and returns its parts
symbols.tests.test_checkpoint.test_save_creates_: All three files exist and are not empty
symbols.tests.test_checkpoint.test_config_round_: Loaded config equals the saved one
symbols.tests.test_checkpoint.test_weights_round: Keys and arrays are exactly equal
symbols.tests.test_checkpoint.test_loaded_model_: Logits are exactly equal after loading
symbols.tests.test_checkpoint.test_non_ascii_cha: Non-ASCII text round-trips through a reloaded tokenizer
symbols.tests.test_data.test_window_table_matche: Shapes and first and last rows match a hand example
symbols.tests.test_data.test_targets_are_inputs_: Targets are inputs shifted by one
symbols.tests.test_data.test_window_counts_for_n: N=3000 gives 2684 train and 284 validation windows
symbols.tests.test_data.test_batches_cover_every: Every window appears once and pairs stay aligned
symbols.tests.test_data.test_load_corpus_joins_r: Text is stripped and missing rows are dropped
symbols.tests.test_generate.SpyRng: Test double that records the sampling distribution
symbols.tests.test_generate.test_top_p_adapts_to: Kept token count depends on confidence
symbols.tests.test_generate.tiny: Helper: builds a tiny config and parameters
symbols.tests.test_generate.test_generate_length: Output length, seed prefix and id range
symbols.tests.test_generate.test_generate_window: A seed longer than `context_len` still works
symbols.tests.test_generate.test_greedy_generati: Temperature 0 output does not depend on the rng seed
